name: AjaxPress – Instant Page Load, AJAX Navigation & Persistent Player
author: ArrayStory

sections.description:
Only 14KB frontend footprint. AjaxPress transforms your WordPress site into a Single Page Application (SPA) with instant page loads and zero reloads — no coding required.

How AjaxPress Works

  1. User clicks a link → AjaxPress fetches only the new content via AJAX
  2. Page updates instantly → Header, footer, sidebar stay intact; only main content swaps
  3. Audio/video keeps playing → No browser refresh means persistent media playback

Why AjaxPress?

AjaxPress includes everything:

  • Full AJAX Navigation (no page reload)
  • Persistent Audio/Video playback
  • AJAX Forms & Comments
  • Page Transitions & Animations
  • Progress Bar & Loading indicators
  • WooCommerce Support
  • Cache Plugin Compatible
  • Only 14KB frontend footprint

Real-World Use Case

Radio Station Website: A WordPress radio site installed AjaxPress. Now visitors browse shows, schedules, and blog posts while the live stream plays uninterrupted in the header. No more angry listeners losing their audio when clicking around the site.

Key Features

  • Zero page reload – Content updates via AJAX navigation
  • Link Prefetch – Pages preload on hover before click
  • Persistent players – Audio/video continues during navigation
  • AJAX forms – Contact Form 7 and comments submit instantly
  • Page transitions – Fade, slide, or custom CSS animations
  • Loading indicators – Progress bar, spinner, or cursor animation
  • Developer hooks – JavaScript callbacks for custom scripts

Perfect For

  • Radio & streaming sites (continuous playback)
  • Podcast sites (episodes keep playing)
  • WooCommerce stores (fast product browsing)
  • Blogs & news sites (instant article switching)
  • Music portfolios (uninterrupted listening)

Works With

WooCommerce, Elementor, Contact Form 7, Yoast SEO, Rank Math, WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, Cloudflare, and most themes. Compatible with HTML5 players, JPlayer, Howler.js, iframe embeds (Spotify, SoundCloud, YouTube), and radio streaming (Shoutcast, Icecast).

Expectations & Limitations

  • Not a caching plugin – AjaxPress speeds up navigation, not initial page load
  • JavaScript re-execution required – Some scripts need reinitialization (settings provided)
  • External links excluded – Only internal links use AJAX navigation
  • Admin area unaffected – AjaxPress only runs on the frontend

Getting Best Results

  1. Enable Script Re-execution – Ensures sliders and dynamic content work after navigation
  2. Use exclusion patterns – Skip checkout, login, and complex form pages
  3. Add analytics tracking – Use “Execute Script After Loaded” for GA4 page views
  4. Test thoroughly – Check all interactive elements after enabling

Support

Support Forum | Plugin Page

Love the instant speed? Please rate AjaxPress 5 stars — it takes 10 seconds and helps thousands of WordPress users discover faster navigation.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for AjaxPress
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Done — instant AJAX navigation is now active
  5. Optional: Visit Settings → AjaxPress to customize
sections.faq:
General

How does AjaxPress make my site faster?

Instead of reloading the entire page, AjaxPress fetches only the content that changes. This reduces server requests and eliminates CSS/JS re-parsing on every click.

How is this different from prefetch plugins?

Prefetch plugins only preload pages in the background. AjaxPress provides full AJAX navigation — the page never reloads at all. You get prefetch plus true SPA behavior.

Does it affect SEO?

No. URLs update via History API, meta tags refresh per page, and search engines crawl normally. Works with Yoast SEO and Rank Math.

Troubleshooting

Sliders/carousels stopped working after navigation?

Enable “Script Re-execution” in settings. For specific sliders, add reinit code to “Execute Script After Loaded” in Advanced settings.

Google Analytics not tracking page views?

Add to “Execute Script After Loaded”: gtag('config', 'YOUR_GA_ID', {'page_path': window.location.pathname});

Some pages not loading via AJAX?

Check exclusion list. External links, target="_blank", and data-no-ajax links are skipped by default.

WooCommerce cart not updating?

Enable WooCommerce compatibility. Add to “Execute Script After Loaded”: jQuery(document.body).trigger('wc_fragment_refresh');

Contact Form 7 not submitting?

Enable “AJAX Forms” in settings. Add reinit code: document.querySelectorAll('.wpcf7').forEach(f => wpcf7?.init(f));

Back/forward buttons not working?

Clear browser cache. Check console for JS errors. Ensure no other plugins manage browser history.

Configuration

How do I exclude pages from AJAX?

Three options: (1) URL patterns in exclusion list, (2) CSS selector exclusion, (3) data-no-ajax attribute on links.

Does audio/video keep playing?

Yes. AjaxPress loads via AJAX without browser refresh, so media players continue uninterrupted. Works with HTML5, iframe embeds, and JS players.

Does it support accessibility?

Yes. Screen reader announcements, focus management, and respects “prefers-reduced-motion” setting.

Need help?

Visit our Support Forum.
